propositions: The snapshot janitor reclaims only on disk-pressure and age axes; a large mostly-empty volume with rapid snapshot generation accumulates entries without bound because all thresholds stay inert.

On the incident host, 13,056+ snapshot entries drove fseventsd to 26.3 GB RSS and 150%+ CPU, exhausting swap and pushing load average to 58, because filesystem metadata pressure was the binding constraint not disk capacity.
The max_entries count-denominated axis must engage independently of free disk space and be ON by default (not opt-in like max_bytes) to prevent recurrence on hosts with abundant free capacity.
Entry-count reclamation must compose with existing hysteresis (target = max_entries * 95 // 100) and respect grace_seconds to avoid evicting entries in active concurrent use.
